mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate venlafaxine-associated hypertension and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
